content.title: A Statement of the Traditional Southern Baptist Understanding of God's Plan of Salvation (2012)
content.author: Eric Hankins and signatories · Journal for Baptist Theology and Ministry 9:2
content.note: A widely signed statement of the non-Calvinist view held by many Southern Baptists. Cited so that, where the Baptist Faith and Message is silent (election, for whom Christ died, the order of new birth and faith), this side is set out fairly. Describe and cite; a short phrase at most.
